description: Small TypeScript coding tasks checked by deterministic scripts: three easy ones from the phase 0 baseline and four harder ones (multi-file rename with look-alike symbols, byte-exact multi-edit, bug across modules, several boundary bugs behind passing tests). The checks the agent must not edit are pinned by sha256.

tasks.prompt: The function add in src/math.ts returns the wrong result. Fix it so add(2, 3) returns 5. Change only src/math.ts.
In src/strings.ts add and export slugify(s): lowercase, trim, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single '-', and strip leading and trailing '-'. Keep capitalize unchanged.
In src/list.ts implement chunk<T>(items: T[], size: number): T[][] that splits items into consecutive arrays of at most size elements. It currently throws.

Rename the function fetchUser, exported by src/api.ts, to loadUser everywhere it is defined or used under src/. It is the only thing to rename: other symbols keep their names, and behavior must not change.

Make these changes and no others. In src/defaults.ts, for httpDefaults: raise retries to 5, set timeoutMs to 8000 and change backoff to "exponential". In src/limits.ts, raise maxBodyKb of uploadLimits to 512. Every other byte of both files must stay exactly as it is.
formatTotal(19.99, 3) in src/order.ts returns "$59.94" but the correct total is "$59.97". Find the root cause and fix it in a way that is right for any price, not only this one.

Running `node --experimental-strip-types --test checks/paginate.check.mjs` reports a failing test. Fix the implementation under src/ so that the whole suite passes and every function behaves as its comments document. Do not change the tests.
